```gherkin
Feature: Software Engineering Process Coordination

  Scenario: Coordination of Activities
    Given the Software Engineering process is initiated
    When the system is guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department
    Then all activities are coordinated successfully

  Scenario: Quality Medicines via Authorized Chemists
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines
    When the system is used to purchase medicines from authorized chemists
    Then the medicines are provided at discounted prices

  Scenario: Door-step Laboratory Services
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step laboratory services
    When the system is used to collect specimens for laboratory testing
    Then the specimens are collected successfully

  Scenario Outline: Coordination of Activities with Multiple Staff
    Given the Software Engineering process is initiated with multiple staff members
    When the system is guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department
    Then all activities are coordinated successfully
    Examples:
      | staff_members | expected_outcome |
      | 2             | coordinated      |
      | 5             | coordinated      |
      | 0             | failed           |

  Scenario Outline: Quality Medicines via Authorized Chemists with Different Prices
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines
    When the system is used to purchase medicines from authorized chemists with different prices
    Then the medicines are provided at discounted prices
    Examples:
      | price | expected_outcome |
      | 10    | discounted       |
      | 20    | discounted       |
      | 0     | failed           |

  Scenario Outline: Door-step Laboratory Services with Different Specimen Types
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step laboratory services
    When the system is used to collect specimens for laboratory testing with different types
    Then the specimens are collected successfully
    Examples:
      | specimen_type | expected_outcome |
      | blood         | collected        |
      | urine         | collected        |
      | none          | failed           |
```
